deploy-bot: 🚀 Deploy started: canary rollout for inference-service -> staging-usw2
commit: redwood/inference@a1b2c3d
tag: v1.14.2-canary-20260319
traffic: 5% -> canary
smoke: running smoke/sanity checks (smoke/sanity)
change-window: 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC
release-notes: https://internal/releases/1.14.2
watch: @priya_sre @josh_eng @liz_ops

kate_pm: quick Q — what's our rollback window and manual pin procedure if we need to revert?

marc_h: rollback window is the usual 30m after promotion. If we need to pin back to previous stable do: 
```
rcloud deploy pin --service inference --env staging-usw2 --tag v1.14.1
```
Also keep an eye on p95/p99 tail.

observability-bot: smoke checks completed: errors 0.01% | p50 45ms | p95 120ms | p99 260ms | traces ok

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% healthy after 3m ✅. Promoting to 20% (automatic step).

deploy-bot: Promoted -> 20%. Running secondary health probes and longer traces sample.

observability-bot: alert: detected tail latency outlier on one host (staging-usw2-i-07xxxx) — p99 ~800ms over 2m window

josh_eng: seeing OOM in that host's container logs around the time of spike, restarting container now. I'll attach logs if it reappears.

priya_sre: hold promo at 20% until restart + rerun of smoke checks. I'll keep tracing open and watch error budget.

liz_ops: holding promotion. ping when green, otherwise we rollback.

marc_h: if we need rollback quickly use the pin I posted earlier. Prefer to hold so user-facing impact is minimal.

deploy-bot: restart completed on staging-usw2-i-07xxxx. Re-running smoke and sampling traces.

observability-bot: smoke re-run: errors 0.00% | p95 115ms | p99 240ms | tail outlier resolved

josh_eng: logs show just a transient mem spike from a bad batch evict; memory limits bumped on that host; monitoring set.

priya_sre: looks healthy from trace sampling. recommend continuing to 60% with a 10m pause after promotion.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 60% now. Will pause for 10m and monitor.

deploy-bot: 60% stable after 10m. No new errors or latency regressions.

kate_pm: :tada: thanks team. After 100% please pin the release and post a short note in #release-notes with the link.

marc_h: ack. After 100% we'll pin stable tag and record changelog entry.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% final.

observability-bot: final checks passing across all hosts: errors 0.00% | p95 118ms | p99 245ms | infra metrics nominal

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — inference-service is now at v1.14.2 on staging-usw2 (100%). Pinning final tag: v1.14.2-release-20260319

deploy-bot: Release notes published: https://internal/releases/1.14.2/changelog (short summary + rollback instructions included)

marc_h: :thumbsup: good run.

liz_ops: leaving thread. will reopen if we see regressions during the rest of change window.

kate_pm: closing the loop — flagged in product tracker and sent summary to stakeholders. Nice work! :white_check_mark:
